resources.string: The text is really deleted from the page content, as in redaction, but no box is drawn over it. Comments, pictures and shapes stay. The result is saved as a new copy.
%d occurrences will be deleted from the page content for good (not just covered). The result is saved as a new copy; the original stays as it is.
This file is signed or certified: the original will not be changed. The result is a new copy, with the signatures removed.
Pages turned into pictures because their text could not be rewritten: %s
